snippet.title: Touhou Danmuki ~ Spellbroken Dream Festival is Available Now!
snippet.description:
東方弾夢記 v1.00a

A Touhou-style fangame by envoidia
envoidia による東方二次創作ゲーム

A full-fledged scene game, in a style reminiscent of Spell Card Collection, Shoot the Bullet, Impossible Spell Card, etc. There are a total of 8 stages and 64 scenes. In addition to creative, unique spell card designs, there are also 3 different playable characters, a myriad of achievements, scoring challenges, and more things to do and goals to aim for.

Download: https://envoidia.itch.io/sdf

Website: https://envoidia.neocities.org
Github: https://github.com/envoidia
Twitter:  https://x.com/envoidia/
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/envoidia.bsky.social
